video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Warriors Pregame w/ Jamahl Mosley 11/16/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the Pelicans' game plan without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: the three-point threat that Steph provides for them where you have to chase him
quotes.quote: The style of play is the same. They are going to play through Draymond and Trayce Jackson-Davis. They are going to make some cuts, moving, they never stop moving. I think that is very similar, but the three-point threat that Steph provides for them where you have to chase him and be alert of where he is on the floor. But the style of play is very similar to the way Steve coaches.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the Pelicans game plan remains focused on Draymond Green and Trayce Jackson Davis despite Steph Curry being out. He notes the Warriors style of play remains very similar under Steve Kerr.

structured.context: Pelicans head coach Jamahl Mosley discusses the Warriors' offensive style and key players ahead of their pregame matchup.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the Pelicans' defensive intensity against the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: It is about us, how do we come out the right way, is our defensive intensity there?
quotes.quote: It is about us, how do we come out the right way, is our defensive intensity there? Obviously we know what they did to us the last time we were in their building, and that should sit home enough. So I do not think there is a worry about if our A-game is going to be there or not. It better be there, and I think that is the mindset and the mentality that we have to approach going into this game.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the Pelicans are looking for redemption against the Warriors after their last meeting. He says the team knows their defensive intensity better be there tonight.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley explains the importance of defensive intensity for the Pelicans following a previous loss to the Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Jordan Poole's recent performance and rotation minutes
quotes.excerpt: he has such a spark to the way he plays. He plays with speed, he plays with pace
quotes.quote: He has such a spark to the way he plays. He plays with speed, he plays with pace, he plays with an ability to get the ball up the court fast, which is what we are trying to do before the defense gets set. He has a high IQ and where he knows where things are on the floor. He is trying to make the right play, the right pass, then trying to sit down and guard, being in the right position. Those are small pieces of why he is finding himself back in the rotation.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley explains why Jordan Poole is back in the rotation, citing his speed, pace, and high IQ. He says Poole is finding his rhythm by making the right plays and focusing on his defensive positioning.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley explains why Jordan Poole has earned more playing time in the Pelicans rotation.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the Warriors' defensive switching and physicality
quotes.excerpt: They are switching, they have always got somebody at the rim
quotes.quote: They are switching, they have always got somebody at the rim that Draymond has coverages where sometimes whether he is on the perimeter, he is going to fly down to the paint to make sure that he is protecting the rim. They have size, they have guys with the high IQ that know where to be on the floor. They communicate, they cover for each other well, they are switching, their physicality. They have done an unbelievable job of that to keep them where they are defensively.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praises the Warriors defensive identity, highlighting their switching, communication, and the way Draymond Green protects the rim.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley breaks down the defensive strengths and communication style of the Golden State Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the physical play of Julian Phillips and Malik Beasley
quotes.excerpt: Julian played out of his mind. I mean 30 and 18, just a physical, dominating Malik played
quotes.quote: Julian played out of his mind. I mean 30 and 18, just a physical, dominating Malik played the right type of game, just understanding who he had to guard, taking on those challenges. I really think that these guys understand how physical they need to be, how tough they need to be, stepping into the moment. That is how we are asking them to play and that is how they have to play in order to step on the floor.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praised Julian Phillips for playing out of his mind during his 30 point and 18 rebound performance, noting that he and Malik Beasley are embracing the physical style of play the team demands.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley praises the physical play and defensive effort of Julian Phillips and Malik Beasley.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Jeremiah Fears' development as a starter
quotes.excerpt: I think he is continuing to grow. In a year two, I think he is learning
quotes.quote: I think he is continuing to grow. In a year two, I think he is learning, he is still striving to find that clean rhythm, but his confidence is at an all-time high. His ability to run the team is what we have continued to ask him to do. Defensively, he has got to be the head of the snake for us, and he is taking on that challenge. He asks the right questions, he watches the film, he is studying at the right way.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says Jeremiah Fears is continuing to grow in his second year, noting that his confidence is at an all time high and he is embracing the challenge of being the head of the snake on defense.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley discusses the development and defensive responsibilities of Jeremiah Fears as a starter.
